shortDescription: Read an env-style file from the remote host and parse its variables

options.name: comment_delimiter
options.description: Optional comment delimiter. When set, full-line comments starting with this string are skipped and any unquoted occurrence in a value terminates the value (everything after it is stripped). When unset (the default), no comment processing is performed.

options.name: encoding
options.description: Encoding used to decode the file content.

options.name: src
options.description: Path to the env file on the remote host.
